settings.restore_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to restore all settings to default values? This action cannot be undone.

connection.title: Game Connection
connection.mitm_required_notice: Riichi City and Amatsuki Mahjong only support External Proxy mode. Please switch the connection mode.

mihomo.description: Let Akagi-NG route target game traffic automatically without Proxifier. Restart after saving.
mihomo.strict_route_desc: Reduces routing leaks but may conflict with virtual networking software such as VirtualBox.
mihomo.clash_compatibility: Clash compatibility chain is enabled: game → Akagi mihomo → Akagi MITM → Clash. Keep the Clash system/mixed proxy enabled. Disable Clash TUN to prevent two TUN cores from competing for routes.

model_config.title: AI Model
model_config.online_proxy_desc: Use this proxy for health, quota, model and online inference requests. HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5 and SOCKS5H are supported.
model_config.ot3_proxy_desc: Use this proxy for health, key, model, inference, purchase, and redeem requests. HTTP, HTTPS, SOCKS5, and SOCKS5H are supported.
model_config.temperature_desc: Adjust the confidence gap between recommendations. Lower temperatures make the top choice more prominent, while higher temperatures make confidences closer.
model_config.temperature_flya_disabled: FlyA-test-api returns only the selected action, not candidate probabilities. Local fallback still uses the saved temperature.
model_config.ot3_account_tools_desc: Inspect the service, key and models, or purchase and redeem keys.
model_config.flya_account_tools_desc: Check service readiness, quota and currently available models.
model_config.quota_destroy_at: The key will be destroyed at {{destroy}}.
model_config.get_key_desc: Join the FlyA community to request a test API key.
model_config.redeem_desc: Mint a new key or add time to the current key.
model_config.redeem_renew: Extend the current key instead of creating a new key
model_config.redeem_new_key: The {{plan}} key ending in {{last4}} was saved.
model_config.redeem_extended: The key ending in {{last4}} was extended to {{expires}}.
model_config.purchase_desc: PayPal opens in your browser and the app waits for the payment result in the background.
model_config.purchase_price_notice: Catalog prices come from Akagi-3 and are display-only. Verify the product and actual amount on PayPal before approval.
model_config.purchase_renew_current: Add the purchased time to the current key (same-plan one-time products only)
model_config.purchase_waiting: Waiting for PayPal approval. You can close this dialog while polling continues.
model_config.purchase_redeem_failed: Payment succeeded but automatic redemption failed. Save this code and retry:
model_config.purchase_key_saved: The {{plan}} key was saved securely; valid until {{until}}.
model_config.purchase_key_extended: The current key ending in {{last4}} was extended to {{until}}.
model_config.purchase_timeout: Payment wait timed out. If you paid, check your PayPal email for the key or redeem code.
model_config.purchase_missing_credential: The server returned success without a key or redeem code.
model_config.purchase_claim_failed: The order claim is invalid or expired. If you paid, check your PayPal email.
model_config.purchase_delivered: The order result was delivered to your PayPal email.
model_config.purchase_failed: The purchase flow did not complete.

desktop.title: Overlay & Tray
desktop.capture_protection_desc: Best-effort exclusion of the visible Dashboard and overlays from OS screenshots and common capture APIs.
desktop.privacy_mode_desc: Hides normal windows and taskbar entries. The process remains visible to the operating system.
desktop.restore_shortcut_desc: Electron accelerator syntax, for example CommandOrControl+Shift+A.
desktop.capture_limit_notice: Capture protection is best effort and cannot cover every OBS version, capture method, or external camera. Discord owns its overlay window, so Akagi cannot directly apply Windows capture affinity to it.

autoplay.delay_mode_desc: Built-in mode uses human timing distributions bounded by your ranges; Advanced samples a separate range for every action.
autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.enabled_desc: Execute the recommended action automatically in the detected game window.
autoplay.window_keyword_desc: Optional. Use comma-separated keywords to force window matching.
autoplay.builtin_desc: The model still reacts to the game state; each dual slider bounds its final minimum and maximum time.
autoplay.advanced_desc: Each action samples independently between its own minimum and maximum.
autoplay.range_first_discard_desc: Total thinking-time range for the first discard of each hand.
autoplay.range_discard_desc: Range for hand discards, drawn-tile discards, and riichi discards after the opening.
autoplay.range_button_desc: Range for calls, wins, kans, nuki, abortive draws, and skip buttons.
autoplay.range_candidate_desc: Extra wait before selecting a call combination or riichi tile.
autoplay.action_first_discard_desc: Thinking time before the first discard of each hand.
autoplay.action_discard_desc: Thinking time before discarding a tile from the hand.
autoplay.action_tsumogiri_desc: Thinking time before immediately discarding the drawn tile.
autoplay.action_reach_desc: Thinking time before clicking the riichi button.
autoplay.action_reach_discard_desc: Extra wait before discarding the riichi tile after clicking riichi.
autoplay.action_daiminkan_desc: Thinking time before clicking open kan.
autoplay.action_ankan_desc: Thinking time before clicking concealed kan.
autoplay.action_kakan_desc: Thinking time before clicking added kan.
autoplay.action_ryukyoku_desc: Thinking time before an active abortive-draw action such as nine terminals.
autoplay.action_nukidora_desc: Thinking time before extracting North in three-player mahjong.
autoplay.action_skip_desc: Thinking time before declining a call or win opportunity.
autoplay.action_candidate_desc: Wait before the second selection when multiple call combinations are available.
autoplay.timing_safety: Changes apply immediately without a notification. UI-readiness checks and a minimum safety interval still prevent clicks during animations.
autoplay.bezier_smoothing_desc: Mouse path curve strength from 0 to 1.
autoplay.bezier_steps_desc: Interpolation steps used during cursor movement.

auto_join.temporarily_disabled: Auto join is temporarily unavailable while its screen-state detection is being improved.
auto_join.enabled_desc: Leave the result screens and join the selected ranked room and match mode after a game.
auto_join.target_desc: Choose a ranked room first, then the match mode inside it. Throne is revealed by scrolling automatically.
auto_join.mode_desc: The mode selected after entering the ranked room.
auto_join.result_delay_desc: Wait after the end-game event before operating the result screen. Increase this if animations run slowly.
auto_join.safety: Auto join only runs after a Mahjong Soul end-game event. A new game, disabling the feature, or a changed target window cancels all remaining clicks.

settings.restart_required: Settings changed, Please restart the application to apply the changes.
settings.restored_success: Settings restored to defaults. Please restart the application to apply the changes.

autoplay_page.title: Automation
autoplay_page.description: Manage autoplay and joining the next match separately on one page.

logs_page.title: Logs and HTTP interception
logs_page.description: Inspect backend logs, MITM requests/responses, and Mahjong Soul telemetry such as CA, IP, machine, and OS data. Sensitive headers are hidden.
logs_page.empty_http: No HTTP captures yet. Enable MITM and launch the game to populate this view.
logs_page.select: Select a request to inspect it

plugins.title: Extension Tools
plugins.description: Manage local extensions attached to Akagi-NG. Disabled plugins do not process game traffic.
plugins.author: Author
plugins.mitm_required: This plugin requires the local MITM. Games launched by NG are routed automatically; external clients still require correct routing and certificate trust.
plugins.no_mitm_required: This plugin does not require MITM.
plugins.game_closed_for_proxy: The proxy route changed, so the active game window was closed. Launch it again to use the new route.

app.title: Akagi Next-Generation
app.backend_starting_desc: Loading the AI service. The dashboard is already available.
app.launch_error: Could not retrieve game URL. Please check settings.
app.standby_desc: Waiting for game data, ready to provide play suggestions
app.hud_desc: AI play suggestions are shown in a dedicated HUD window
app.shutdown_confirm_desc: Are you sure you want to quit Akagi NG? This will exit the application and disconnect all connections.
app.stopped_desc: Thank you for using Akagi NG.

status_messages.fallback_used: Online service unavailable. Switched to local model.
status_messages.game_disconnected: Game connection lost. Check your network or refresh the page.
status_messages.lib_missing: Local core components (lib) are missing or incomplete. The application cannot run properly.
status_messages.models_missing: Local model files (models) are missing. The application cannot run without an online model configured.
